about: ERW, What is on an electricity bill (/learn/bill): the cases the replication draws the calculator for (session 7533, chain 304). A case is a bill and the values a reader would type in the calculator's fields; a field not named keeps the bill's default (site/data/bill_rules.json). The five defaults are the page's own; two cases type EIA's 2024 average residential month (Electric Sales, Revenue, and Average Price, Table 5A: California 503 kWh, Texas 1,096 kWh); the others move each field the page offers at least once, among them the two that printed a floating-point kWh before this session (SCE Region 9 in summer, SDG&E with a 333 kWh allowance).
